title: Oggy and the Cockroaches
description: Oggy, an anthropomorphic cat, would prefer to spend his days watching television and eating, but is continuously pestered by three roaches: Joey, Marky and Dee Dee. The cockroaches’ slapstick mischief ranges from plundering Oggy’s refrigerator to hijacking the train he just boarded. In many situations Oggy is also helped by Jack, who is more violent and short-tempered than him and is also annoyed by the cockroaches. Bob, a short-tempered bulldog, also appears in the show, and is Oggy’s neighbor.

episodes.title: S1-E44It's Been a Hard Days Noise

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Oggy gets a box of cherry-chocolates delivered to his home and goes inside to enjoy them. However, the roaches - Joey, Marky and Dee Dee have decided to take it for themselves, and a chase begins throughout the house. Jack nurses Oggy and vows to get back the box of sweets, even if it involves blowing up the house.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: During an afternoon, Jack is snoozing on his hammock while Oggy is tending the garden. The cockroaches jump into Jack's head so that they can control him to wreak havoc on Oggy.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Oggy and Jack won the lottery ticket number for a massive sum of money, but the cockroaches want the lottery ticket for the much-needed money as well.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Poor Oggy, as usual, gets in an accident involving Jack against the cockroaches in retaliation of his cake being eaten, ending up being squashed into a disk. To make sure he'll never repeat that mistake twice, Jack builds a time machine to go back in time and prevent the accident. Unfortunately for him, turning forward - and back - the clock may yield unwanted results.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Oggy and Jack, after eradicating the cockroaches from their house, receive 3 baby kittens that look like Jack - little do they knew and suspect that these bundles of joy are actually the roaches in disguise, obviously in retaliation for being kicked out of the house.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Oggy finally manages to remove the cockroaches out of his home permanently, but gradually regrets doing so, as he starts to miss them, leading to a severe tantrum.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Oggy is playing with his doll and its included playhouse. The cockroaches, however, have taken the playhouse for themselves and when Marky spots the doll, he falls in love with it. This results in Oggy making an all-out siege on the playhouse to take back what's rightfully his.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Oggy, in order to get his driver's license, takes driving lessons with the driving instructor. The cockroaches, of course, try their best to shift the chaos into turbo.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Oggy arrives at home after shopping and trips over a small pup. He takes it inside and start pinching his own nose as a squeezing toy to play with the pup. When Jack arrives he, of course, begins to think that Oggy has gone crazy as Jack and the pup are not seen simultaneously.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: While Jack takes up mountain climbing, Oggy intends on reading a good book from his library, only to end up getting stranded in some very high book shelves by the cockroaches, while Jack is having problems of his own at the mountain. Looks like it's going to be a real long way down for both of our feline friends...

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Oggy gets his hands on a new, super bouncing-ball. He decides to try it out and it soon bounces all over the house, wrecking everything in its path. And things don't get any better when Joey accidentally swallows it.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: Oggy was sent to the hospital when he tripped over down the stairs in pursuit while Jack watched over him. Unfortunately for him, the cockroaches decide to take a visit to the hospital - just to make an already bad situation worse for Oggy.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Oggy desperately needs to use the bathroom, but the cockroaches have it occupied and do all what they can to keep him out.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: A wizard quietly sleeps over at Oggy's house for the duration of the day. Meanwhile, the cockroaches fight over the usage of his flying broom against Oggy.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: While helping to catch the cockroaches, Jack starts acting like a ruthless, superior-minded Dictator to Oggy, reducing him to a downtrodden proletariat - an action he will live and come to regret, as that will evolve into a struggle between control and freedom...

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Jack and Oggy were making and preparing Duck Soup for their dinner, with the main ingredient being the duck itself – until a lot of its angry, protesting friends show up.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: Oggy puts a solid padlock on the fridge to stop the cockroaches pesky behaviour.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Jack is building a skyscraper in Oggy's back garden. However, when helping in the making of this building, Oggy experiences a complete acrophobia until Jack helps to get him to sleep. But the problems are just getting started. Oggy is sleepwalking, and to make matters worse, the cockroaches are around to sabotage the skyscraper at all costs.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Taking a simple bath soon escalates into a desperate struggle for Oggy when the cockroaches sabotage it, especially when our blue feline can't swim and has a severe case of hydrophobia. Can Jack help him overcome this seaborne problem?

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: Using a photocopier, Oggy shrinks himself down to the cockroaches' size in order to infiltrate their home and take back the key to his padlocked fridge.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Oggy invites his date over to his house for dinner. However, he starts to get jealous when cockroach Marky falls in love with her. And soon, this jealousy will escalate a brawl...

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Jack has to pay a debt. He brings into Oggy's house a suitcase full of money, for Oggy to look after it. And Oggy becomes paranoid knowing that all that money is in his house.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: After witnessing Oggy receive money from the tooth fairy, Joey plans on getting some himself. He is unwilling to give this up, even if this means losing all of his teeth in the process.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: While Jack is hooked on video games, Oggy tries to pass the time by playing with a train set. However, when the cockroaches come aboard, he soon becomes a part of their roller coaster.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: The carnival has come to town, and Oggy and Jack are more than happy to go into it. Unfortunately, the cockroaches also decide to go the carnival, just to have massive fun wreaking havoc all over the place...

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: After seeing Oggy's new remote-controlled lawnmower, the cockroaches forge their own cat-destroyer machine that looks like a mouse, but acts like an alligator.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 27
episodes_data.description: The cockroaches' latest prank on Oggy has them inflating his stomach, making him think that he's pregnant. However, he'll soon find out that only girls can have babies, and not boys...

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 28
episodes_data.description: After seeing a snake charmer on TV, Oggy decides to make his own flute, in which he steals a car part from his neighbour Bob. Upon adding holes to it, Oggy plays it and unwittingly hypnotises cockroach Marky into being a dog that would remain loyal to him, much to the dismay of cockroaches Dee Dee and Joey.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 29
episodes_data.description: A bedouin, who is lost and parched in as desert, finds a magic lamp. He uses his three wishes to get a palace, a pile of gold and lovely girls - but he forgets to wish for water. The genie flees after being attacked by the infuriated bedouin and of course, ends up in Oggy's house.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: It's all out Cyberspace War as Oggy, with his vacuum cleaner, and Joey takes the daring voyage in the internet in order to return to the real world - however, system errors, bugs, power flows and even Jack himself are hellbent on slowing Oggy and Joey down...

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 31
episodes_data.description: Oggy's granny comes to visit. It's her birthday and what she wants is three dead cockroaches.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: Oggy is going to the beach for what he thinks will be a relaxing day off. What he doesn't notice, is that the cockroaches has decided to tag along. And when Oggy and the cockroaches are near each other, trouble is bound to happen.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: The cockroaches fight Oggy over getting a sun tan. Their main scheme this time has them in a tire-made hot-air balloon under the guise of a rain cloud.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: The cockroaches play a hit-and-run prank where they frame Oggy by dressing up as him and attacking Jack.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 35
episodes_data.description: Jack bought Oggy a remote control car and they want to race with them, but then the cars are now annoyances and chasing - and chased by - the cockroaches to run them all over.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 36
episodes_data.description: After getting himself trapped in a drink bottle, cockroach Dee Dee is kidnapped by Oggy and locked up in the fridge. Upon seeing this, Marky and Joey attempt to get past Oggy's newly installed defences and save their fellow roach by all means, at all costs.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 37
episodes_data.description: Jack takes Oggy on a Sunday trip with the beach as the destination. The cockroaches decide to tag along. But trouble is always around the corner when the cockroaches are placed in a small space (Jack's car in this case) together with the two cats.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 38
episodes_data.description: After consuming a piece of irradiated chocolate (obviously placed in the box by the cockroaches), Oggy transmutates into a cockroach himself! How will Jack react to this?

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 39
episodes_data.description: What started out as a sip from a simple cup of coffee turns into intensely strong hiccups for Oggy. And while attempting to steal his fridge, the cockroaches get involved with his situation.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 40
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee is just swimming on Oggy's yogurt, when, unknown to him, Oggy drinks it up, and Dee Dee along with it. Dee Dee then travels around Oggy's insides and decides to give Oggy the mother of all indigestions.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 41
episodes_data.description: The cockroaches rent Oggy's house to a redneck who kicks Oggy out. In trying to get his house back, Oggy finally rents it out to a wrestler who is even worse.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 42
episodes_data.description: Jack takes Oggy on a fishing trip, with neither of them knowing that cockroach Dee Dee has come along with them. While Jack keeps a large fish at bay, Oggy is learning how to fish whereas Dee Dee is eating all of the bait.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 43
episodes_data.description: Three alien cockroaches from another world (obviously genetically resembling Dee Dee, Marky and Joey) visit Oggy's household. They constantly shape-shift Oggy and Jack into different objects and share good moments with the regular cockroaches.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 44
episodes_data.description: Oggy wants to listen to his music CD in peace, but the cockroaches decide to pump up the volume into and beyond acceptable limits.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 45
episodes_data.description: Oggy has a fear of flying, and while taking him on a flight, Jack tries hypnosis to help him relax. However, while a relaxed Oggy has gone walkabout around the plane, the cockroaches have come aboard as well, in which they leave all of the pilots tied up and gagged in order for them to cause the usual sabotage.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 1 Episode 46
episodes_data.description: Oggy and Jack have a meal out at a fancy restaurant. Unfortunately, things take an unexpected and a real bad turn, as the cockroaches are stealing their orders and Jack can't wait any longer to tuck in.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Oggy befriends an octopus which the cockroaches want to eat. Little does Oggy know this octopus makes a habit of plotting robberies - for example, when Oggy was at his most unaware when he sleeps and gets relaxed, the Octopus sniggers and pulls Oggy's stuff into his head.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Oggy has a new job shaving sheep. For him, even here, the cockroaches are there, ready to get Oggy in trouble - for the shear love of it.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Oggy and Jack are assigned to keep watch over a toxic waste plant, briefed to make sure no monkey business will make this plant go nuclear. But while Jack is sleeping on the job, Oggy has to take damage from the cockroaches, trying his best to avoid sending the entire waste plant sky-high.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: When Oggy and Jack go on vacation yet again, the cockroaches tag along, then the cruel cats plan on leaving them behind at a convenience store which only destroys their car.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Our favorite feline is invited to a extravagant V.I.P. party. As always (if you're familiar with Oggy), the cockroaches come along and turn this party up one notch too high as Oggy suffers torture by Marky and Dee Dee, while Joey has eyes for Cinderella and her only.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: When our not so deliberate duo, Oggy and Jack, take up scuba diving in Hawaii during their vacation, not even water can stop the cockroaches from tagging along and taking the plunge to cause their usual mischief - this time under the great blue.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: While walking home, Oggy finds a pair of magic shoes that can dance on their own whenever spit-shined. Oggy soon becomes famous with the toe tappers. All goes well until the cockroaches ruin everything.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Oggy receives his 1 million Euro payment. Jack spends it all on a casino joint. And of course, the cockroaches come along for the ride.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Right in the middle of this Christmas night, Santa Claus, while doing his routine gift delivery services, experiences - and gets disabled by - cockroach-related technical difficulties, so Oggy volunteers to do his job for him. Too bad the cockroaches are trying to take the "merry" out of Oggy's merry Christmas tonight - festive anything-goes style.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: After being run over by a car, Oggy discovers he has superpowers, and Jack becomes his sidekick in order to protect the world from villainy. However, both cats always get into trouble.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Jack is preparing an airplane flight, while Oggy gets on the wrong flight and the cockroaches are the pilots.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: One day, Oggy discovers that all of the vegetables in his house are alive! So naturally, the vegetables are saved. But when Oggy gets hungry, they may have to resort to change Oggy into a predator.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: The big day has arrived when Oggy gets invited to the marriage of his best friend, Jack, and a French poodle, promising to be cockroach-free, but Dee Dee, Marky and Joey come along for the wedding too, uninvited, just to raise a little heck... well, so much for that "No Cockroaches Allowed" policy of the invitation.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 14
episodes_data.description:
Jack is preparing an airplane flight, while Oggy gets on the wrong flight and the cockroaches are the pilots.

Oggy and Jack are on a wild safari. They run into friendly insectivore natives who accidentally make Jack unconscious which the cockroaches take advantage of.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Oggy and Jack fall overboard on their cruise ship and fall on an island. While Oggy is enjoying himself, Jack is trying to leave. Meanwhile, the cockroaches are being kidnapped by a roach eater.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: A witch drops a strange invention - an enchanted telescope, namely - in Oggy's house. When the cockroaches use it, they grow to gigantic size - and of course manage to shrink Oggy, Bob and Jack.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: While doing laundry, Oggy discovers of a chicken that can lay eggs... but not just any egg - golden ones. When the cockroaches learn of this, they try to get one of her eggs too for profits.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: After catching him in the fridge, Oggy manages to kill cockroach Dee Dee, but he did not realize that Dee Dee was just playing dead. Also, Joey and Marky calls the police and a crime inspector to make this even worse for Oggy.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: Oggy is in China and the cockroaches are there also causing mischief. With that, Oggy sells them to a Chinese merchant but then starts to think he made the wrong decision.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: The cockroaches' latest prank on Oggy is trapping him under the house, Jack hears of it and makes the cockroaches go down to save him. However, Jack must first sign the contract that if the cockroaches save Oggy, they will humiliate Jack by recording him dancing like a ballerina.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: The cockroaches hire a termite to help them get in the cupboards. However, this termite causes problems with Oggy and Jack.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Oggy is exploring scenic Hollywood, and the cockroaches try to bug him. The chase leads them to several movie scene parodies.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Oggy and Jack are playing mini golf in Oggy's yard. The cockroaches show up to cause trouble for Jack, while Oggy keeps getting a pefect score.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Oggy finds a past form of a cockroach frozen in his garden. The kind cockroaches unfreeze him, later finding out the really, really hard way that what cockroach they've thawed is a wild cat eater - which equals Oggy is bound to end up becoming the main item in a prehistoric cave-bug's menu.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: Jack brings Oggy a horse for a horse show. Oggy plans on getting famous for riding it but becomes only a show the cockroaches can enjoy.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: Oggy and Jack are out surfing but Oggy is stuck with the big board. Plus, after he manages to control it, the cockroaches make things worse for him and Jack.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 27
episodes_data.description: Oggy must protect the banks' money, but the cockroaches steal his forklift, and Oggy has to get it back once and for all!

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 28
episodes_data.description: Jack opens up a pizza delivering business and Oggy is the deliverer. But Oggy's job becomes difficult once the cockroaches steal Oggy's every order.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 29
episodes_data.description: Oggy adopts a crab knowing that it keeps the cockroaches away, However, the crab soon gets a bit... clingy to Oggy much to his dismay.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 30
episodes_data.description: Oggy's grandmother returns which means bad news to the cockroaches. Considering, Oggy's grandmother drinks a power coffee, making her super strong against them.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 31
episodes_data.description: The cockroaches lock poor Oggy out of his house. Now Oggy must find a way back in before his house is trashed.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 32
episodes_data.description: Oggy is up to his breaking point with the cockroaches so he moves to the city. Feeling sad and lonely, the cockroaches try to look for him - but when they show up in his new apartment room, something tells the city there's not enough room for the both of them.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 33
episodes_data.description: While watching a bunch of old cartoons, Oggy and the cockroaches are transported in the projector. Oggy then finds the characters who want to teach him a little something about cartoons.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 34
episodes_data.description: Oggy finds another cat that is a near-perfect replica of himself (save for a white spot on his tail). When Jack learns of this, he decides to play a cruel joke on the cockroaches making them think that Oggy is everywhere, resulting in double the trouble, double the laughs.(There's a deleted scene in this episode. When Joey finds out that Oggy follows him in space, there's a part that his head exploded. But since it was deleted due to censorship, the result is the scene when he cries.)

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 35
episodes_data.description: Cockroach Joey is hit on the head and treats Oggy like a role model. Now Marky and Dee Dee must try to change him back.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 36
episodes_data.description: Kindhearted Oggy takes in a cicada hoping to use her sound for relaxation, not realizing it gives Joey a headache.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 37
episodes_data.description: Oggy and Jack climb aboard on a submarine, but the cockroaches come along and take over the entire ship.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 38
episodes_data.description: Oggy and Jack attend Bob's police training camp, and the cockroaches sabotage Jack's every task and then somehow made Oggy win.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 3 Episode 39
episodes_data.description: Jack invites Oggy to see him participate as an F1 racer in the big Formula 1 tournament being hosted at the circuit arena. But when the cockroaches come with the cats to get their race on, havoc-wreaking bug style, things are about to go way too turbo for Oggy and Jack to stomach.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: When a new girl cat named Olivia moves into Oggy's neighborhood, he instantly falls in love with her. But, not only are Bob and Jack (who are working together) also pining for Olivia, when the cockroaches see the whole thing, they pull out all the tricks they can to throw a wrench into this relationship.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Oggy and Jack become lighthouse keepers for the day. While Jack gets a fear of heights, Oggy once again chases Marky and Joey, who have the book, while Dee Dee is directing boats all over the place.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Oggy and Jack find a new job − Oggy and a sleep deprived Jack become garbage men. But the worst has just come as the cockroaches mess up the controls and things go crazy.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Dee Dee thinks he is too fat so he decides to go on a diet.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: During a lovely day in the yard, Joey photoshops some pics and makes Oggy believe that he has had a fling with Olivia, the lovely neighbor. Oggy turns jealous and begins to act very strangely. No one can understand why.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: It's Joey's birthday. And Marky and Dee Dee decide to throw a surprise party. The two post an invitation on the internet and hundreds of roaches show up the next day.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: After Oggy gets everything ready for Jack's birthday party, things go airborne as the roaches blow up all the hot air balloons with helium and release them in the attic, eventually making the house fly into the city.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Exasperated at being once again, victim to the roaches' practical jokes, Oggy orders a mysterious kit. When the kit arrives, it turns out to be an airtight, hermetically sealed CCTV room where he can close himself up and then, with help from a console, activate various traps he has set all over the house.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: Oggy and Jack go hiking on the GR 20 trail across the island of Corsica... so do the roaches. They sabotage Jack's compass and the two cats get lost in the wild, which turns out to be pretty frightening.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: Oggy has just washed his clothes, and is about to dry them, when the cockroaches come up and steal the clothes, starting a battle between them on the clotheslines.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: Oggy's relatives arrive at Oggy's house for a visit. As such, Oggy is determined protect his visitors from the roaches' plots, or else the visit will turn into a historical disaster.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: The roaches have trapped Oggy with lights and nailed his shadow as they are about to, as usual, raid the fridge. When Oggy breaks free, his shadow is still trapped and then becomes stray. Will Oggy be able to get his shadow back?

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: One day, Oggy finds a parrot which repeats anything he says and does, and decides to take it home. As the parrot is at Oggy's house, Dee Dee becomes very obsessed with the parrot, and wants to get its feathers only for... food?

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: A pencil with a magical drawing ability has just fallen onto Oggy's house yard, and the cockroaches plan to use it against Oggy.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Oggy finds a weird cube on his yard, and decides to take it to his living room, not knowing the cube soon causes trouble for his friends as it grows bigger until it entrances him.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 16
episodes_data.description: Oggy has problems expressing his feelings for Olivia. To make matters worse, the roaches come along to ruin Oggy's every attempt to impress Olivia.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 17
episodes_data.description: When a helicopter lands on Oggy's yard, Oggy deicdes to take control of it for a while. Suddenly, Joey falls in love with the helicopter, thinking it's a giant female dragonfly and leaving the other roaches in confusion... and harder for Oggy to control it.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 18
episodes_data.description: Olivia notices a pimple on her face and refuses to leave her home. What will Oggy do to help Olivia get rid of the pimple?

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 19
episodes_data.description: It's an icy day, and when Bob crashes into a fire hydrant, Oggy's yard turns into a large ice rink. Oggy and Olivia decide to have some fun on the rink by going skating.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 20
episodes_data.description: After being electrocuted, Oggy and Joey turn into a realistic cat and a realistic roach. Nobody recognizes them, not even Jack nor Marky nor Dee Dee.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 21
episodes_data.description: Following an explosion provoked by the roaches, the house and everyone inside find themselves in outer space and heading straight for the sun!

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 22
episodes_data.description: Olivia is taking part of a marathon, and Oggy comes with a bag with a bottle of water inside. However, the roaches, as usual, also come with him and are up to no good, stealing the bag, resulting in a big chase while the race is on.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 23
episodes_data.description: Marky eats some tree seeds which make him grow really, really big, turning him into a giant roach who wants more and more food.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 24
episodes_data.description: Oggy gets a package containing a spray bottle, which he hopes to be able to kill the roaches. However, as the roaches have it in their hands, they have made everything droopy and soft.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 25
episodes_data.description: After the cockroaches destroy Oggy's TV, Oggy and Jack make the cockroaches do Olympic events themselves.

episodes_data.title: Oggy and the Cockroaches Season 4 Episode 26
episodes_data.description: Oggy gets a new job as an apprentice cook in a chic, modern restaurant. Bob is his boss. All is good until the cockroaches come along and try to sabotage Oggy's work.
